title: SG-5.3 Wire dust, ambient light and fade transition from content
summary: Create dust, ambient light and the fade scene transition from scene content in the scene builder and Phaser scene
description: Context: game/src/engine/buildScene.ts builds only SceneObjects, and sceneSchema in game/src/content/schema.ts has no effects. Desired behavior: dust, ambient light and fade transition are authored in the scene YAML, created by the builder, and run by the Phaser BootScene. Expected result: effects exist because content declares them. Why: lets future AI cycles add effects without engine rewrites.
acceptance_criteria: Given a scene YAML with an effects list, when it is parsed, then dust, ambientLight and transition entries validate and invalid ones return path-named errors
Given a scene with effects, when buildEffects runs, then effect entities are created on the effects layer depth and a fade transition is played
Given BootScene.create runs, when the scene content declares effects, then they are created through a Phaser-backed context and removed on shutdown

preserve: buildScene return type and RenderContext interface

technical_constraints: Use existing assets effect:dust and effect:glow from manifest.json
Keep Phaser out of game/src; runtime logic uses an injected context
definition_of_done: All three requirements have Act and Verify units passing
